name: agentx
description: Skills and the agentx tool server (read-only by default) for working with a self-hosted AgentX node from Claude Code.

tools.title: AgentX tool set
tools.description: Which agentx tools Claude Code gets: read (look only, the default) or full (also send messages, start tasks and change schedules).

daemon_url.title: AgentX node address
daemon_url.description: The address of your AgentX node. Leave empty for a node on this machine (http://localhost:18800).

token.title: AgentX token
token.description: Needed only for a node on another machine: that node's MESH_TOKEN.
